# Fixture corpus

The round-trip harness (`tests/round_trip.rs`, binary `hwp-roundtrip`) diffs
our codec's output against real HWP files generated by **hwplib**
(canonical HWP binary writer, Java).

## Vendored from hwplib

These files are vendored verbatim from the
[neolord0/hwplib](https://github.com/neolord0/hwplib) repository's
`sample_hwp/` directory (Apache License 2.0). Re-fetch with:

```sh
curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neolord0/hwplib/main/sample_hwp/blank.hwp        -o blank.hwp
curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neolord0/hwplib/main/sample_hwp/merging-cell.hwp -o merging-cell.hwp
```

| file              | bytes  | what it tests                                      |
|-------------------|--------|----------------------------------------------------|
| `blank.hwp`       | 22,528 | `BlankFileMaker.make()` baseline — empty document  |
| `merging-cell.hwp`| 10,752 | row_span / col_span on cell LIST_HEADER parsing    |

Add more from `sample_hwp/` as new code paths come online (image,
equation, distribution, etc.).

## Recommended progression

Start with the smallest file and add bytes only after the previous one is
byte-equal:

1. `blank.hwp`           — `BlankFileMaker.make()` output, no text
2. `one_char.hwp`        — one paragraph containing a single Hangul char
3. `one_paragraph.hwp`   — one paragraph, CharShape + ParaShape non-default
4. `one_table.hwp`       — 2×2 table, one cell has background color
5. `image.hwp`           — one embedded PNG
6. `equation.hwp`        — one inline equation (LaTeX-convertible)

Each stage surfaces a new encoder path in our writer. The runner's
`first divergence` output tells you which stream/record to tackle next.

## Runner

```sh
cargo run -p hwp-transpiler-codec --bin hwp-roundtrip -- \
  crates/codec/tests/fixtures/blank.hwp
```

Semi-auto watch (install [`watchexec`](https://github.com/watchexec/watchexec)
or [`cargo-watch`](https://github.com/watchexec/cargo-watch) first):

```sh
./scripts/watch-roundtrip.sh crates/codec/tests/fixtures/blank.hwp
```
